OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. SCOPE OF WORK ============== The scope of the vendor shall include the supply of genuine OEM spare parts for the existing Hot Disc TPS 2 200 – High Temperature Thermal Conductivity Analyzer installed at the Centre of Excellence (COE) - Lube, HP Green R&D Centre (HPGRDC), Bengaluru. The vendor shall: 1.1. Supply new, genuine, and unused OEM spare parts fully compatible with the existing Hot Disc TPS 2200 s ystem.

1.2. Supply the following components: S. No Description Quantity 1 Kapton sensor (With Cable) (Up to 50 °C) (HD-RTK-W-CBL 50) (5501) 1 2 Kapton sensor (With Cable) (Up to 50 °C) (HD-RTK-W-CBL 50) (5465) 1 3 Macor sensor holder for use on the room temperature sample holder 1 (max 750 °C), including LEMO cable (STEEL-MACOR-750) 4 PCM /Liquid Sample Holder – From India 1 1.3. Ensure that all supplied items conform to the OEM's latest specifications and are suitable for integration with the existing instrument without requiring any modification to the hardware or software. 1.4. Ensure proper packing, handling, and transportation of the supplied items to prevent damage during tra nsit. 1.5. Provide warranty/guarantee against manufacturing defects and workmanship as per OEM standard term s. 1.6. Provide technical assistance, if required, for identification, fitment, compatibility verification, and commi ssioning support of the supplied spare parts. 1.7. Replace any defective, damaged, or non-conforming items supplied under this purchase order at no addi tional cost to HPCL during the warranty/guarantee period. 1.8. Ensure delivery of all items within the agreed delivery schedule along with all relevant supporting docum ents, including tax invoice, delivery challan, warranty certificate, and OEM authorization documents, where ver applicable. 2. Technical deliverables – Vendor Responsibility 2.1. Supply genuine OEM spare parts for the existing Hot Disc TPS 2200 system. 2.2. Ensure full compatibility of supplied parts with the existing instrument. 2.3. Provide product datasheets and relevant technical documentation. 2.4. Provide warranty/guarantee certificate for supplied items. 2.5. Provide delivery challan, packing list, and tax invoice. 2.6. Replace any defective or damaged items supplied under the order. 2.7. Provide technical support related to fitment and compatibility, if required. 2.8. Ensure safe packing and transportation of all supplied items to HPGRDC, Bengaluru. 3. SCOPE OF HPCL 3.1. Provide access to the existing Hot Disc TPS 2200 instrument for compatibility verification, if required. 3.2. Share instrument details and configuration information necessary for identification of the required spare parts. 3.3. Coordinate with the vendor for delivery scheduling and material acceptance. 3.4. Inspect the supplied items upon receipt for quantity, physical condition, and specification compliance.

3.5. Provide necessary site access and support for compatibility verification, if required. 3.6. Issue material acceptance after successful verification of supplied items and submission of required doc uments. PRICE REDUCTION CLAUSE / LIQUIDATED DAMAGES =========================================== Not Applicable. PERFORMANCE BANK GUARANTEE/ RETENTION ========================================= Applicable as per HPCL’s General Terms and Conditions for Supply.
